title.narrative: HPN - Cluster 2: Fahari ya Jamii - FP/RMNCAH, WASH & Nutrition (Nairobi County)

description.narrative: (Kenya): Using FY 2022 funds, USAID will continue its support for the Fahari ya Jamii activity to increase the use of quality county-led health services in Nairobi through a service delivery systems strategy. The activity will utilize a multi-sectoral approach involving Health, Water, Education and Agriculture sectors to connect local health issues to larger development challenges through integrated population, health, and development activities in Nairobi and Kajiado counties. The activity will specifically focus on Nairobi's informal settlements which have a high unmet need for family planning (FP)/ Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child and Adolescent Health (RMNCAH) and WASH interventions. . ..More specifically the activity will:.Build the capacity of county and sub-county health managers on leadership management, accountability and governance to enhance ownership and reduce donor dependency.Create awareness within counties on domestic resource mobilization approaches and ring fencing of health budgets, so as to increase and secure health related budgets.Improve access to antenatal care and skilled birth attendanceImprove health information systems to provide quality and timely data in the District Health Information Software 2 package.Build strong integrated commodity supply systems at the facility, sub- county and county levels.Increase access to safe point-of-use water treatment; generate movement along the sanitation ladder; and increase the adoption of key hygiene behaviors.
